memory: Biexponential adsorption confirmed. τ_fast (H2O) = 64±6, 100±9, 160±11, 255±18 s at 25–10°C. D2O shows ≈35% longer τ_fast (15°C 215±16 s; 10°C 345±24 s). JFET anchoring, 300 s purge and extended D2O blanks mitigate anomalies. Arrhenius fits yield Ea ≈65 kJ·mol⁻¹; isotope appears as near‑constant multiplicative offset (intercept change) not slope. Remaining caveat: D2O 25°C and 20°C were inferred from the offset, not independently measured.
